question: Which statements on the record cannot both be true?
method: recorded contradiction pairs with the source of each side. These are not resolved by the system; they are carried until a document resolves them.

results.asrc: Federal rationale for the stand-down request, July 2019
results.b: The federal prosecution ended on 10 August 2019, and the material was still withheld in 2026
results.st: Unreconciled. The stated reason expired roughly 18 days after it was given; the withholding outlasted it by more than six years.
